title: Review test · Unit 4 · Places and predictions

fn.en: Show control of Unit 4: future forms, probability and enquiry language.

can.en: I can make predictions, say how likely something is, and ask for information politely.

useful: I look forward to hearing from you

items.q: I’ve looked at the calendar. I ___ move the boat on Friday.
The phone is ringing. — Don’t worry, I ___ answer it.
Look at those clouds. It ___ rain.
I think floating houses ___ become completely normal.
___ you going to stay there when you retire?
The percentage ___ rise to about ninety-two per cent by 2030.
People who live near green spaces ___ be physically active.

items.from: It is very probable that the number will rise.
items.cue: Rewrite it with LIKELY. Begin: The number…
items.a: The number is likely to rise

items.from: I have made the decision already: I am keeping the boat.
items.cue: Rewrite it with DECIDED. Begin: I’ve decided…
items.a: I’ve decided to keep the boat
alt: I have decided to keep the boat

items.r: an area of houses on the edge of a city
shared by a group rather than owned by one person
send out a smell, a gas or heat

items.s: The path was so ___ that we had to stop twice.
